words: If you know what toes are, then you know that they curl down back towards the foot, and the foot itself is much flatter than where the top of the knuckle of the toes are. But what you've created is a foot that not only is like twice as wide as the other foot, but it doesn't have any definition past the first knuckle. It needs to dip back down flat after the knuckle to create the actual profile of a foot, like you see on the approved sheet image. Because what you've created is just a block.
